memories.author: D03
memories.text:
60-year-old man presents for evaluation of vitamin D deficiency and suspected fatty liver.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: He reports intermittent fatigue and mild discomfort in the right upper quadrant for 2 months, no jaundice or fever.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/82 mmHg, pulse 76/min, weight 78 kg, height 1.65 m, BMI 28.6 (obese). Abdomen soft, mild hepatomegaly, no tenderness. No pedal edema.
IMPRESSION: Vitamin D deficiency, non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease with mild enzyme elevation, borderline lipids.
ARRANGEMENTS: Start cholecalciferol 60 000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks then 1000 IU OD; silymarin 140 mg TDS; rosuvastatin 5 mg OD. Order fasting lipid profile, fasting glucose, serum 25‑OH vitamin D, calcium, phosphate, LFT. Advise reduced‑carb diet, 150 min/week brisk walk. Influenza vaccine not due (outside autumn season). Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39 °C, dark urine, worsening abdominal pain, or jaundice.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
60‑year‑old man returns for 3‑month review of vitamin D deficiency and NAFLD.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Fatigue improved slightly; no new abdominal pain.
EXAMINATION: BP 126/80, weight 77 kg, BMI 28.3 (obese). Abdomen soft, liver edge palpable 2 cm below costal margin.
IMPRESSION: Vitamin D deficiency still insufficient; NAFLD with improving liver enzymes; lipids trending down.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD (maintenance); silymarin 140 mg TDS; rosuvastatin 5 mg OD. Repeat vitamin D, LFT, lipid panel in 3 months. Advise maintain weight loss goal 5 kg, avoid alcohol. Return if worsening fatigue, jaundice, abdominal swelling, fever >39 °C, or unexplained weight loss.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
60‑year‑old man for 6‑month follow‑up of vitamin D deficiency and NAFLD.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Feels well, no fatigue, no abdominal discomfort.
EXAMINATION: BP 124/78, weight 76 kg, BMI 27.9 (overweight). Abdomen soft, no hepatomegaly.
IMPRESSION: Vitamin D now sufficient; NAFLD stable with normal enzymes; lipids at target.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD; silymarin 140 mg TDS; rosuvastatin 5 mg OD. Offer influenza vaccine – given today 05‑Oct‑2025. Advise maintain Mediterranean diet, 150 min/week activity. Return if new jaundice, abdominal swelling, fever >39 °C, chest pain, or unexplained weight loss.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
60‑year‑old man annual review of vitamin D status and NAFLD.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Asymptomatic, reports good energy levels.
EXAMINATION: BP 122/80, weight 75 kg, BMI 27.5 (overweight). Abdomen soft, liver not enlarged.
IMPRESSION: Vitamin D adequate; NAFLD non‑progressive; fasting lipids within target; fasting glucose normal.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD; silymarin 140 mg TDS; rosuvastatin 5 mg OD. Influenza vaccine status: up‑to‑date (given Oct 2025). Advise maintain weight, limit fructose, annual lipid and glucose labs. Return if jaundice, abdominal distension, fever >39 °C, new cardiac symptoms, or unexplained weight loss.
